##### There are some shortcuts available.
- 1) Ctrl+c and Ctrl+v for normal copy and paste of texts
- 2) Ctrl and hover over the blocks you want to select, Ctrl+shift and hover to deselect the blocks, and esc to cancel all selections
- 3) Ctrl+y to copy the selected blocks ,and Ctrl+p to paste the copied blocked below the selected block
- 4) Ctrl + 1 for getting paragraph ++p --p when you start editing a new block, likewise, Ctrl+2 for list, Ctrl+3 for table and Ctrl+4 for div

##### Starting the server
- 1) node index.js -> starts the normal server opening readme files at port 3000
- 2) node index.js folder_name 3100 -> creates if not present and starts new project of that name at port 3100, using this approach you can work on multiple projects at the same time.

##### Running server in background
- a) ./server.sh start              # starts default project which is root readme
- b) ./server.sh start blog 8081    # starts blog project at 8081
- c) ./server.sh start chat 8082    # starts chat project at 8082
- d) ./server.sh status blog        # check blog
- e) ./server.sh stop chat          # stop chat
- f) ./server.sh stop               # stop default
- g) ./server.sh                # prints help info
